marlowcrystal.config.title: Coco802 Crystal Reflex
marlowcrystal.config.keep_render.descrip: Keeps a broken crystal visible until the server removes it. It stops blocking your crosshair and the next placement straight away. If the server did not break it, it can be hit again as soon as that is known, and at the latest after 1.5 seconds.
marlowcrystal.config.reflex_mode.descrip: Enables the client responsiveness layer and the F8 toggle. It never creates clicks or aim input.
marlowcrystal.config.raw_mouse.descripti: Uses GLFW raw mouse motion when supported to avoid OS pointer acceleration and reduce input filtering.
marlowcrystal.config.totem_guard.descrip: Tracks offhand totem state and enables the manual F7 carried-slot resync for stale client inventory state.
marlowcrystal.config.update_source.descr: Where to look for new versions built for your Minecraft version and mod loader.
marlowcrystal.config.experimental_builds: Also offers beta builds when looking for new versions, not only full releases. Beta builds can still change before they are released.
